# ICS Computer Store — Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India

> Coimbatore's premier IT hardware store since 2007. Custom gaming PC builds,
> enterprise networking, 4K CCTV surveillance, and chip-level motherboard repair.

## About Us
ICS Computer Store (also known as Infant Computer Store) has been serving
Coimbatore since 2007. We are a GST-registered dealer located at 240/A2B,
Sarada Mill Rd, near Koushikha Hospital, Podanur, Coimbatore – 641023.

## Services
### Custom PC Assembly
Pick your budget and workload. We assemble, cable-manage, and run 24-hour
AIDA64 & 3DMark stress tests on every rig. Free assembly with component purchase.

### Enterprise Networking
Cat6/Cat6A structured cabling, server rack deployment, managed PoE switches,
multi-WAN firewall routers, and Ubiquiti UniFi enterprise Wi-Fi installation.
Free site survey across Coimbatore.

### CCTV Surveillance
4K ColorVu IP cameras, 8/16/32 channel NVR/DVR, live remote mobile streaming,
and Annual Maintenance Contracts. Brands: Hikvision, CP Plus, Dahua, EZVIZ.
4-camera kit starts from ₹14,990.

### Biometrics & Access Control
Face recognition, fingerprint, and RFID card readers with HR/payroll integration.
Magnetic door locks for server rooms and labs. Brands: eSSL, Realtime, ZKTeco.

### Chip-Level Repair Lab
In-house lab with digital microscopes, IR BGA rework stations, and oscilloscopes.
Dead motherboard diagnosis, BGA reballing, short-circuit repair, BIOS reflashing.
Inspection from ₹499.

### Printers & Consumables
Ink tank & laser printers, barcode printers, document scanners.
Brands: Epson, Canon, Brother, HP, TVS-E.

### Accounting & ERP Software
Authorized partner for Busy Accounting and Tally Prime.
GST e-way bill, e-invoicing setup, data migration, and staff training.
